title: Add interactive RAG contract playground + accessible TypeScript workshop
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Add new interactive RAG playground and TypeScript workshop for contract-first authoring; accessibility improvements to authoring studio; new smoke CI to cover the playground and contract linter.
description:
Context and motivation: This PR adds a compact, interactive RAG 'Contract Playground' and a short TypeScript workshop for developers who want to author retrieval-augmented agents with explicit tool contracts and accessible authoring flows. The goal is to provide a low-friction onboarding path (live sandbox + step assertions) that demonstrates contract-first tool binding, structured output validation, and keyboard/screen-reader friendly examples.

What changed (high level): Added a docs playground page under /playgrounds/contract-playground with an embedded TS runner, a minimal mock indexer backend used by the smoke CI, an example contracts schema, and updated authoring-studio accessibility styles. Also included a small authoring checklist and a stepwise assertion snippet for unit-style prompt tests.

Why now: Several customers requested clearer examples for tool contracts and deterministic assertions during rollouts. Internal feedback from Solutions and Docs indicated the authoring UX was a barrier when using keyboard-only flows. This PR addresses both areas and ties the example into the platform's structured-output linting guide.

Checklist: - [x] Playground page and static assets added - [x] TypeScript workshop tutorial (10–15 min) added to quickstarts index - [x] Contract schema examples and linter rules wired - [x] Accessibility audit fixes for focus order and aria-labels - [x] Smoke CI test that boots the mock indexer and runs e2e authoring flow - [x] Docs site navigation entry and quick link added

Files of note (short summary): - docs/playgrounds/contract-playground/index.md: documentation + embedded demo iframe instructions - docs/playgrounds/contract-playground/example-contracts.json: contract-first tool schemas + examples - examples/ts/contract-workshop/: mini TypeScript workshop runner and README with steps to run locally - examples/mock-indexer/: small Node HTTP server used by the playground and smoke CI - website/static/playground-iframe.js: iframe helper and a minimal runner for the embedded sandbox - website/styles/authoring-accessibility.css: focused accessibility fixes (focus outlines, skip links styling) - .github/workflows/playground-smoke.yml: new CI job that launches mock-indexer, loads the playground, and asserts step contract linter exit code

Commits (summary): - c1f9d2c add contract playground skeleton and index page - e8a7fb4 add TypeScript workshop runner and examples - b5ff045 wire example-contracts into contract linter and docs - 91d2aab add mock-indexer server used by e2e smoke tests - 7aa3c11 accessibility: fix focus order, aria labels, add skip-link - 3c2e7d4 add CI smoke workflow and makefile target for local dev - 5f4b9e0 fix: minor copy edits and error handling in mock-indexer

Changed files (high level): - docs/playgrounds/contract-playground/index.md (new) - docs/playgrounds/contract-playground/example-contracts.json (new) - examples/ts/contract-workshop/{README.md, run.sh, workshop.ts} (new) - examples/mock-indexer/server.js (new) - website/static/playground-iframe.js (new) - website/styles/authoring-accessibility.css (modified) - .github/workflows/playground-smoke.yml (new)

Review timeline and discussion (condensed into single narrative): Initial draft submitted 2026-02-12 by @maya-chen. @Arjun Patel flagged two concerns on 2026-02-13: 1) the contract schema used nested objects that could confuse the linter runner; 2) the iframe runner loaded third-party fonts synchronously which caused early layout shifts. I replied the same day and pushed commit b5ff045 to flatten the example schema and replace font loads with system stacks.

On 2026-02-14 @Leila Gomez called out accessibility nit: the playground's keyboard focus order skipped interactive step buttons in the embedded runner. I pushed 7aa3c11 to rework tabindex and add explicit aria-describedby for step results. Manual testing notes: tab order tested with VoiceOver and NVDA (basic flows).

CI history: The initial CI run failed on 2026-02-15 due to a flaky timeout in the smoke job that boots the mock-indexer; job logs showed the mock server sometimes started >6s on GitHub actions runners. I added a retry/backoff in the job and a Makefile wait-for script in commit 3c2e7d4. Re-run passed on 2026-02-16. Final CI green on 2026-02-19.

Approvals and merge: After addressing the accessibility and CI timing issues, @Samir Rao gave an approval on 2026-02-19 with a minor suggestion to add a short troubleshooting section in the workshop README; I added a small troubleshooting block in the workshop README and pushed 5f4b9e0. Squash merge was performed on 2026-02-20 (squash and merge).

Backwards compatibility and rollout notes: This is a pure docs + examples change and does not affect runtime APIs. The new smoke CI protects the embedded sandbox against regressions; ops should be notified if the mock-indexer container images need updates.

How to try locally: 1) cd examples/mock-indexer && npm ci && npm start 2) cd examples/ts/contract-workshop && npm ci && ./run.sh (runner will open http://localhost:8080/playground?mockIndexer=http://localhost:9000) 3) Run make playground-smoke to run the local smoke script that mirrors CI

Related work and references: ENG-1824 for playground roadmap; DOC-341 for workshop curriculum; internal accessibility audit ticket SUP-9081 referenced above.

Additional notes: Kept the playground sandbox intentionally minimal to reduce maintenance surface area. We purposely did not include an on-demand large model backend; the workshop uses a deterministic local stub so authors can repeat assertions reliably.
